title: Links under AppData leak inside the Claude and Codex apps
explanation: One cause of NTFS file records (pool tag NtFC) piling up while the Claude or Codex desktop app runs: a bug in bindflt.sys, the filter behind the AppData of Microsoft Store apps. Inside the app's package, every open through a junction or symbolic link located under AppData leaves one record behind until a restart, from its terminals, tools and hooks too. The same open by the real folder, through a link elsewhere, or from a program outside the app leaves nothing.
workaround: Reach the files without such a link: replace each PATH entry that goes through one with the folder it leads to, and move uv, pnpm and the Codex command-line tool out of AppData with their own variables, then reinstall what they hold. These measured 0 new records. A restart frees what has built up.
suggestion: Opens through links under AppData leave these behind (traced by peterlau03 on GitHub). PoolWatch shows each link it finds and how to fix it.
